description: Requires the connected Fold account. Turns Fold's order-status text messages on or off (orderTexts: picked up, out for delivery, delivered; when off, the same updates arrive by email) and marketing emails on or off (marketingEmails). Only the fields passed change. Returns the resulting settings.

marketingEmails.description: Offers and news by email on (true) or off (false).

orderTexts.description: Order-status text messages on (true) or off (false).

name: update_notification_preferences
title: Update order-update texts/emails
